input.clause_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice.
In no event shall the Provider's total liability exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
Each party shall hold the other's Confidential Information in strict confidence and not disclose it to any third party.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
The Company may terminate your employment immediately for Cause without severance.
The Provider shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client against any and all claims, including unlimited consequential damages.
This paragraph is intentionally left blank and imposes no obligations on either party.
